notes.title: Patch 1.0.12b - Accessibility Options and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]
Today's patch tries to ease and make the game more comfortable for people sensitive to light.[/p][p][/p][p]The Glitch Effect in particular can cause a lot of discomfort for some players. If you are sensible in any way to lights or bright patterns we highly suggest it to be disabled.[/p][p][/p][p][b]SETTINGS[/b][/p][p]All the following settings were added to the Graphics Section[/p][list][*][p]Added a Bloom Slider;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Film Grain Slider;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Glitch Effect Slider;[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a mistranslation for Research Scrap B in Brazilian Portuguese;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the rotation of the Scraps being inverted;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you experience any bugs and would like to report, feel free to share them with us on our official discord!  [/p][p][/p][p]Have a great day, [/p][p]and be wary of the dark.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10 - Japanese Localization and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 

For our Japanese community, we're very sorry for the delay, but at last Japanese Localization is live.[/p][p][/p][p]It required some changes in the game structure and in conjunction with other localization related bugs, the build was not so stable and that's why we decided to keep it cooking a little longer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]JAPANESE LOCALIZATION[/b][/p][p]The Japanese option for language will now be enabled and work. [/p][p]It's possible we missed a thing or two since Japanese is not our native language and we relied on voluntary effort so feel free to report any wrongs that we may have overlooked![/p][p]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause Clara's Diary to be completed when loading a game under specific conditions, causing a softlock. (Thanks SirCabby and PaPaJDub)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the Inventory to not change language if the Player picked something and later decided to change language using the settings. (Thanks Otafumiga)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause the Entrance door to be open when it should not under specific conditions. (Thanks SirCabby)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Rank Achievements not being awarded to the Player in Specialist Mode. (Thanks Spaced)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause the Nun to stay permanently in the Bathroom after a good shower. (Thanks RafaelRAS)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you experience any bugs and would like to report, feel free to share them with us on our official discord!  [/p][p][/p][p]Have a great day, [/p][p]and be wary of the dark.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - Checkpoints & Fake Credits Tuning
notes.content:
[p]Hello Everyone!  [/p][p][/p][p]Sorry to keep you waiting. We've been working non-stop to deliver the following changes that will help mitigate Player Frustration and Misdirection about the game content. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Checkpoint System[/b]  [/p][p]In response to Player frustration about having to redo large amounts of content, we introduced mid-act checkpoints. The progress of individual puzzles and your inventory will be remembered in case you... Wake up again.  A total of 5 Checkpoints were inserted and if reached can be recognized by a new notification. They're positioned in content hiccups that may cause tedium, specially after repeated deaths.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Fake Credit Tuning[/b]  [/p][p]A small percentage of players are being misled by the End of Act I in which a "Fake Credit" sequence plays and end up quitting the game believing it is over.  [/p][p][/p][p]To alleviate this problem we made the sequence 90% shorter.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Flow of Act III [/b] [/p][p]Although Player sentiment is favourable about the dynamics of Act III, we identified that the "flow" of the content is not as smooth as it should be, causing unnecessary aimless wandering.  To resolve this the following changes were made: [/p][list][*][p]Main Objectives moved in proximity to each other;[/p][/*][*][p]Nun "Reveal" Duration: 30 seconds -> 60 seconds;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Bug that caused the sound cue for the last objective to not play;[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We released this patch as fast as we could while trying to retain a very stable experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Internally, we did not identify major game breaking bugs but it is possible that some, minor & major, might have slipped through without our knowledge.  [/p][p][/p][p]We will keep monitoring closely and will respond immediately to any major bugs surfacing and disrupting Player experience.

If you experience any bugs and would like to report, feel free to share them with us on our official discord!

Have a great day,
and be wary of the dark.
[/p]

They're positioned in content hiccups that may cause tedium, specially after repeated deaths.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Release Day Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, we really want to thank you for playing the game and would like to apologize for any inconveniences caused by bugs on the release day.[/p][p]

Players that previously played the [b]Blasfemia Demo [/b]may have their save files corrupted.
What does a corrupted save file compromises?[/p][olist][*][p]Earn a selection of achievements;[/p][/*][*][p]Find Collectibles;[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Because of this I implemented in haste some features:
[/p][p][b]SAVE DATA MANAGEMENT[/b][/p][p]A new option named "Save Data" was put in the "Settings" that allow Players to reset their progress (New Game+, Specialist Mode and Collectibles) or only Collectibles;[/p][p]

[b]SAVE DATA CORRUPTION DETECTION[/b][/p][p]If your save files was compromised by the Demo a Warning will pop up in the main menu notifying you about it and asking if you want to proceed with corrections or ignore them;

Once again, we're truly sorry for the inconveniences this could have caused.[/p][p][/p][p][b]GAME VERSION WATERMARK[/b][/p][p]We removed the game version being visible at all times due to Player feedback. It will only show in the Main Menu now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]JAPANESE LOCALIZATION[/b][/p][p]Unfortunately, we could not get the Japanese Localization ready for release date but we're working hard to ship it in a future update as fast as we can. We're sorry for this!  [/p][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a Bug with Clara's Research Diary on Act III that caused Fire, Water and Wind translations not work at all;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Bug with Ranking Calculation that would set Ranks outside of S, A, B and C;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Bug with skipping the First Tape that could lead to a soft lock;[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]KNOW ISSUES[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Nun during Act III may cause a lingering "Glitch Effect" on Player's screen if spotted from within the Bathroom;[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Not all Collectibles will show up on the Gallery as soon as they're picked up;[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory Items will not localize correctly if the game language is changed during gameplay;
[/p][/*][/list][p]If you experienced bugs and want to report them, feel free to join us on discord and share it with us!  
[/p][p]Have a great day, [/p][p]and be wary of the dark.[/p]
